text: Welcome to the Dream Park!\c\nWhere dreams become reality and Fossils\nbecome Pokémon!
Do you have any Fossils on you?\nDo you wanna turn ’em back into Pokémon?
Which Fossil do you want to restore back into\na Pokémon then?
All righty! You just leave it up to me!\c\nI’m gonna turn that [VAR 0109(0000)] of\nyours back into a Pokémon lickety-split!
What, you don’t want me to restore your Fossil?\nTch! Don’t you get how amazing this chance is?

I turned that Fossil of yours right back into the
Pokémon it used to be!\c
This here is [VAR 0101(0001)]!
You’d better take right good care of it!

Hmm? Now color me surprised!
Your team’s just packed with Pokémon!\c
I guess I’ll just have to take care of this lovable
little lug until you come back with some space!

Someday this whole place is going to be filled
to bursting with Pokémon from the ancient past.\c
That’s my dream for this: the Dream Park!
To bring the ancient world back to life!

If you want to meet mysterious Pokémon that
disappeared from the world long ago...\c
Then you’ll have to find some Fossils first!
You do know about Fossils, right?
If you find any Fossils, you can have my pa\ntake a look at them for you.

Fossils are the remains of ancient Pokémon
that have been preserved in the ground.\c
They can be restored and brought back to life
so we can meet those ancient Pokémon again!\c
What do you think? It’s pretty amazing, right?

Wow!
You’re pretty amazing yourself!\c
You’ve found every known Fossil that can be
restored into a living Pokémon, haven’t you?\c
That is just so amazing that I think I will have to
give you a little reward!\c
This is your proof of being a Fossil Master!

Are you a Fossiphiliac, too?
A Fossil fan, my fine [VAR 1100(00FF,0403)]boygirl!\c
If you are, you might know the answer to this...\c
What did my sweet [VAR 0109(000A)] turn
into when I had it restored?\c
If you’d like to see for yourself, how about a
Pokémon battle?
That’s a real shame! Don’t let that refusal\nfossilize—come back and fight me anytime!
That’s right! Sweet little [VAR 0109(000A)]\nbecomes a fine [VAR 0101(000B)]!
I hope I’ll get to meet more sweet little Fossils\nsoon, not just my [VAR 0109(000A)]!
